resources.string: MiraiCast Lab is capturing the screen
MediaProjection experiment running. Stop it from the app.
Lets MiraiCast Lab measure whether it can send keys and gestures to DeX

MiraiCast Lab uses this only to test whether an app can drive a Samsung DeX desktop with emulated keyboard and mouse input. It is off unless you enable it, it does not read screen content, and it sends nothing anywhere - the app has no internet permission. Turn it off when you are done testing.
